title: MLEvolve: A Self-Evolving Framework for Automated Machine Learning Algorithm Discovery

mechanism.populationDetail: Progressive Monte Carlo Graph Search maintains graph/tree search nodes and cross-branch reference edges; exact graph-to-population semantics remain partly unclear.
mechanism.archiveDetail: Candidate scores and graph statistics guide search, but separate elite archive semantics are unspecified.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Graph search with cross-branch information sharing is not a conventional flat population; archive/update rules need method verification.
mechanism.generationDetail: Candidate code can be generated by full rewrite, stepwise editing, or localized diff mode selected hierarchically by the planner.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Execution outcomes, algorithm objective/validity metrics, and memory inform later planning and generation.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Graph/node selection and cross-branch memory are reported, but true editable parent count and exact selection rule are not explicit in note.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Progressive Monte Carlo Graph Search with cross-branch information sharing plus hierarchical adaptive code-edit granularity and retrospective memory.
